currency.basis: Commons inception 2019-04-25 and current bbva.com brand pages found via search corroborate the 2019 identity as the brand in current use; the accepted icon's rounded letterforms predate it. Official-site retrieval failure disclosed separately.

identity.basis: The angular stroke-built BBVA wordmark is the 2019 BBVA identity; the file shows exactly the letters BBVA in that style, matching the brand of the bank record BBVA (PT).

assessment.independenceRationale: Commons file page is a third-party publication with its own upload provenance; the rebrand date is corroborated by bbva.com brand pages found independently in search results. The failed official retrievals are disclosed rather than counted as support.
uncertainties: First-party asset bytes from bbva.pt/bbva.com could not be fetched (403/transfer failure); currency rests on Commons plus corroborating brand-page search evidence.

variant.basis: Standalone monochrome wordmark #004580, no accompanying slogan or explanatory text; the letters themselves form the mark. Catalog presentation (backing/circle) is decided at candidate preparation, not here.

candidate.detailsJudgement: All letterform details (stroke-built B's, angular V, caret-style A) survive conversion and optimization; the Skia/painterResource renders on both themes show sharp, complete letterforms with no lost counters or distorted joints.
candidate.proportionsJudgement: Wordmark aspect ratio preserved (uniform scale); placed at 48/54 width the emblem fits fully inside the circle with clearance (vertical extent about 14.4 of 54). At 24/32/48 px diagnostics the wordmark remains recognizable, comparable to the accepted icon's lettering size; the white circle is invisible on the light theme background, which is expected for a neutral white field and does not harm legibility.
candidate.rationale: Evidenced 2019 BBVA rebrand: the accepted pre-2019 circular lockup with rounded letterforms is replaced by the current angular stroke-built wordmark (Commons BBVA_2019.svg, inception 2019-04-25, collated clean serialization from worldvectorlogo). Supported rebranding justifies the update.
transforms: Working SVG rebuilt from the fetched vector: outer <g> carried over unchanged except removal of the Illustrator class-based fill, replaced by the identical literal fill #004580 on the group.
Whole-emblem placement only: uniform scale 0.024020 and translation centering the wordmark (viewBox -.004 0 1998.364 600.414 -> width 48 of 54), no rotation, stretch, crop or redraw.

Catalog backing added: plain white circle r=27 behind the emblem; the source has a transparent canvas and no brand field, so the neutral white circle is a catalog presentation adaptation chosen for dark-theme legibility, not part of the official design and not an observed official avatar.

SVGO 1.x (repository svgo.config.mjs) run on a copy: 6134 -> 5405 bytes; selected optimized result; rsvg render comparison shows only <=1/255 channel rounding differences, geometry and colors unchanged.
candidate.variant: 2019 standalone BBVA wordmark (#004580) on a constructed white circular catalog backing; the letters themselves form the mark, no accompanying text.
candidate.visibleDiffExplanation: Accepted icon: pre-2019 rounded BBVA letterforms, white on a blue (#004580) circular field. Final: current 2019 angular wordmark in brand blue #004580 on a white circular field. The change is the evidenced 2019 rebrand (new letterform design) plus inversion of the field/emblem roles so the emblem keeps its official brand color without recoloring; before/after renders on both themes show a clear, meaningful redesign difference, not a serialization change.

proposals.reason: Found a current original-vector replacement: the 2019 BBVA wordmark. The accepted icon reproduces the pre-2019 circular lockup with rounded letterforms; BBVA rebranded in April 2019 to the angular stroke-built wordmark, corroborated by the Commons file page (captioned 'BBVA wordmark (2019)', inception 2019-04-25) and bbva.com brand pages found in search. The primary Commons original (Adobe Illustrator export) contains DOCTYPE ENTITY declarations that the pipeline rejects, so the candidate binds a byte-clean single-group copy from worldvectorlogo (plain fill=#004580, no DOCTYPE/entities/raster/text) whose rsvg render was visually compared against the Commons original: identical geometry and color. Supported rebranding justifies the update.

sourceCandidate.rationale: Original vector artwork of the current 2019 BBVA wordmark. The bound bytes are a serialization copy collated byte-for-byte geometry-identical (by render comparison) to the Wikimedia Commons Illustrator original; provenance of the artwork is the 2019 BBVA identity, not a raster trace. Suitable standalone mark: the letters themselves form the mark.

sources.independenceGroup: worldvectorlogo upload, visually collated to the Commons original (serialization copy of one artwork)
sources.observation: Byte-clean vector of the 2019 angular BBVA wordmark: 6036 bytes, single <g fill="#004580"> over vector paths, no DOCTYPE/entities, no raster, no text elements. rsvg render visually identical to the Commons Illustrator original BBVA_2019.svg (same letterforms and color).

sources.independenceGroup: Wikimedia Commons file page and uploaded original (one publication)
sources.observation: Commons original: Adobe Illustrator 23.0.1 SVG export, single path, viewBox 0 0 3543.2 1059.5, fill #004580, captioned 'BBVA wordmark (2019)', inception 2019-04-25. Rejected as candidate material only because of DOCTYPE ENTITY declarations; retained as the provenance and geometry reference for the collated copy.

Official bbva.pt returned HTTP 403/empty and bbva.com brand-logo page failed with a transfer error; first-party asset bytes unretrievable. Disclosed retrieval limitation, not a currency contradiction.
